description:
Send a message to TESSA's sales team, the same as the contact form on
        tessa.tech. TESSA replies by email within one business day. Use this when
        the user wants TESSA to contact them but does not want to book a call.
        Only call it when the user has asked to and has given their real email.

        prospect_email:   the user's email (required; temporary inboxes are refused)
        prospect_name:    the user's name
        prospect_org:     the user's company
        project_brief:    the message
        requested_window: optional, when they would like to hear back
name: contact_tessa
title: Send TESSA a message
